quickSummary: During amplexus, nuptial pads grip the female, synchronizing external fertilization in water. The aquatic tadpole larva is herbivorous with a long coiled gut, gills, swimming tail, and ammonotelic excretion. Metamorphosis is strictly driven by thyroid-secreted Thyroxine (T4), which requires dissolved Iodine: tail and gills are resorbed, lungs/limbs develop, gut shortens drastically for carnivory, and excretion shifts to urea.

summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: Thyroxine ($T_4$) drives metamorphosis. If water lacks dissolved Iodine ($I_2$), metamorphosis is arrested and the tadpole remains a giant aquatic larva.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
FROG DEVELOPMENTAL METAMORPHOSIS
                                     │
   Fertilized Egg (In Water) ──► TADPOLE LARVA (Herbivorous, Aquatic)
                                     │
   Thyroxine Hormone Cascade ◄── Thyroid Gland Secretion (Iodine-dependent)
                                     │
   METAMORPHOSIS CHANGES:
   ├── Tail and Gills Resorbed via Autophagy / Lysosomal Enzymes
   ├── Lungs and Limbs Develop
   ├── Intestine Shortens drastically (Carnivorous Adaptation)
   └── Nitrogenous Waste Shifts: AMMONIA (Tadpole) ──► UREA (Adult)
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Amplexus & External Fertilization**: During breeding season, the male mounts the female, gripping her with glandular nuptial pads on his forelimbs. As eggs are spawned into water, the male simultaneously deposits sperm over them.
• **Tadpole Larva Characteristics**:
  1. Free-swimming aquatic larva equipped with a finned **swimming Tail**.
  2. Breathes via **external and internal Gills**.
  3. Strictly **herbivorous** with a **long, spirally coiled intestine** to digest algae.
  4. Excretes **Ammonia (Ammonotelic)**.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Hormonal Control & Iodine Dependency
conceptBreakdown.title: Hormonal Control & Iodine Dependency
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Thyroxine ($T_4$) Regulation**: Metamorphosis from an aquatic tadpole into a terrestrial frog is driven exclusively by Thyroxine secreted by the **Thyroid Gland**.
• **Iodine ($I_2$) Prerequisite**: Thyroid synthesis of thyroxine requires dissolved environmental iodine. If tadpoles are reared in iodine-deficient water or undergo thyroidectomy, **metamorphosis is permanently blocked**, resulting in giant neotenic-like tadpole larvae.
